model_annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of responses to the statement "Design is well-integrated into the product development process in our organization" and is divided into five categories. The chart has five slices, each corresponding to a different level of agreement. The categories are: "Fully integrated" (blue, approximately 12%), "Very well integrated" (orange, approximately 28%), "Well integrated" (green, approximately 29%), "Poorly integrated" (red, approximately 9%), and "Not integrated at all" (purple, approximately 23%). The chart includes a legend that maps the colors to their corresponding labels, and the percentages are not directly labeled on the chart but can be estimated based on the given numbers (10, 24, 25, 8, 20). The slices are arranged in no particular order, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
